description: Create one reviewed typed event (movement, purchase, sale, import, export, death, slaughter, disposal, or identification). Supply a canonical payload with populations, optional movement/identification facts, explicit inventory effects, and links. Structures are authoritative; incomplete but meaningful facts are allowed. Requires a caller request_key for idempotent retry.

payload.description: Versioned schema 1 payload: { schema_version: 1, kind, event_date, populations[], movement?, identification?, inventory_effects[], links[], notes? }.

request_key.description: Opaque caller key (1-200 characters); identical retries replay.
